title: Of 136 real single-expression line edits, the fix replaces the site's expression 84.6% of the time; a site-rooted, proximity-ordered pool contains the fix for 5.9% of them. Writability is 77.4% of code edits, reachability by text proximity is 5.9%: the bottleneck is material selection, not vocabulary, not grammar, not search size.

supersedes_bottleneck_claim.published_claim: "Observability binds computer use; expressibility binds coding" and "the vocabulary is the bottleneck, and vocabulary is bought by recording, not by searching".
supersedes_bottleneck_claim.what_the_real_history_says: Expressibility is 9.1% of 241 real code edits and 77.4% of code edits are a single expression the enumerator can already write. Being writable is not being findable: the same pool writes the fix but contains it within 400 ordered candidates for only 5.9% of edits.
supersedes_bottleneck_claim.why_the_earlier_number_was_wrong: It was measured on QuixBugs, whose 40 published bugs are one-expression repairs by construction. On real code the fix usually discards the site's expression (84.6%), and a pool rooted at the site cannot reach an expression the site does not contain.

writability_241_real_single_line_edits.note: A necessary condition only: names in scope, node budget, and a form the enumerator implements. It does not say the pool will order the fix early, and measurement 3 shows it usually will not.

geometry_136_real_single_expression_edit.note: 62 of the 241 edits are code that spans lines and 43 change nothing that is a single expression; they are excluded from this denominator, not reclassified.

reachability_of_the_same_136_edits.pool_construction: site-rooted single edits, ordered by material distance: the site, the block the site guards, the function, the class, the module; 400 candidates; nothing executed

end_to_end_real_commit_click_1b0e19f505.human_fix: self.show_envvar and self.envvar is not None
end_to_end_real_commit_click_1b0e19f505.oracle: the project's own tests/test_options.py at the parent commit with the post-fix test file: test_missing_envvar fails, message "Error: Missing option '--foo' (env var: 'None')."
end_to_end_real_commit_click_1b0e19f505.identifiability_note: The two survivors differ only for a falsy non-None envvar (the empty string). No test asks that question, so the suite cannot separate them. This is a limit of the oracle, reported, not a success.

the_bottleneck: Candidate material is chosen from the source text; the evidence that chooses it lives in the failing run's values. Grammar (9.1%), statement form (7.5%) and pool size (median rank 22 when reachable) are all smaller and already measured.
the_build_this_implies: instrument the failing case and record the value the site produced, its type, and the value the test demanded
nominate material by provenance of the demanded value in that run, not by text proximity
search the expressions that can produce the demanded value from that material, one hole, sized by the value's type
keep the project's own tests as the oracle and spend the budget on ordering

falsifier.claim: value-provenance material puts the human fix in the pool for more than 5.9% of them and within 40 candidates for more than 6 edits
falsifier.if_false: the thesis is wrong and this file is superseded, not patched

limits: 25.7% of the 241 edits (62) are code that spans lines and are excluded from the geometry denominator
the 29-commit sweep is a population of one-line source changes that also touched a test, not of bugs; rows with no oracle are reported as NO_ORACLE and are not successes
the sweep's identification is a producer-run sandbox result; independent reproduction is open
